info.name: Legal
info.description:
Privacy Policy and Terms of Service content.

Base URL: {{baseUrl}}

GET /legal/:slug is public — no JWT required. PATCH /admin/legal/:slug requires a JWT for a user with role ADMIN.

Content is stored in the LegalDocument table (seeded from API/PRIVACY-POLICY.md and API/TERMS-OF-SERVICE.md), not read from disk at request time — the markdown files are only the initial seed. Reads are cached; updates invalidate the cache immediately.

Supported slugs: privacy-policy, terms-of-service. Any other slug returns 404.
